run_ppo_agent_example: run the simple PPO agent example with a checkpoint and logdir for the minitaur environment
load_config_from_logdir: load the environment config from a logdir using utility.load_config to get policy and value layers
create_simple_ppo_policy: create a SimplePPOPolicy agent with a TensorFlow session, environment, network, and checkpoint path
get_action_from_agent: get an action from the PPO agent by passing a list of observations to agent.get_action
run_environment_episode_loop: run an episode loop that steps the environment with agent actions until done and sums rewards
